videos.title: Creator of TypeScript: Why We Chose Go For Our Rewrite | Anders Hejlsberg
videos.summary: Ever wonder why the TypeScript team chose Go over the industry-darling Rust when porting their compiler to native code? Programming language legend Anders Hejlsberg reveals the pragmatic engineering reality: real-world compiler data structures are full of circular references that fight Rust's borrow checker, making Go's built-in garbage collection and shared-memory concurrency the vastly superior choice. Watch this clip to learn how top language architects balance raw performance against real-world compiler architecture.

timestamps.topic: The limits of JavaScript: Concurrency and performance bottlenecks
